Behaviour is 0099's again: a same-facility acceptance is no longer compared with its ehr.prescriptions row (0100's PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND, PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_ACTIVE, PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH and PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_MISMATCH are no longer raised), and a same-facility work item is dispensable again after its prescription is cancelled, held, completed, entered in error or changed (0101's PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_DISPENSABLE is no longer raised); 0077's checks, PRESCRIPTION_ROUTED and both order-route branches are byte for byte the same in all four bodies; pharmacy.validate_dispensing_reversal() is unchanged; existing work items and dispensings are not touched (INSERT triggers).
